### Extent vs Scope
The task requires fixing tax application so it rounds once on the subtotal rather than per line item, using three 33-cent items with 10% tax as a reference case. The diff modifies only `invoice.py`, swapping a per-item generator for a single call against a pre-computed `subtotal`. This directly satisfies the scope; `taxes.py` contains the rounding logic and requires no modification. I did not inspect `test_invoice.py` or the full repository tree, but the host's acceptance check confirms existing coverage passes.

### What the change does
The diff stops tax from being applied repeatedly to individual line items. It sums all item prices first into a subtotal, then applies `with_tax()` exactly once to that total. The docstring is updated to reflect this single-application behavior.

### Defects Found
None. The fix correctly implements the requested behavior and aligns with the provided example. Host measurements confirm structural validity and test passage without regressions.

### Assessment
No defects to report. The change precisely targets the stated root cause (cumulative per-item rounding) and leaves unrelated modules untouched. Existing tests pass, and no new failure modes are introduced by this diff.
